recentItems.title: What Locals Really Think | The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo | A Call to Gather
recentItems.description:
What do local people really think of the Tattoo in August?

We sat down with people from, or living in, Scotland who have been to the show, to find out what they really thought.

Whether you're from the other side of the world or from right here in Scotland, the Tattoo is for everyone.

Don't miss your chance to be part of it this year. Book now:https://eu1.hubs.ly/H0wFRph0

recentItems.title: The Heroes Who Made Us Overseas Tour at Suncorp Stadium, Brisbane, Australia.
recentItems.description: What a spectacular opening night for The Heroes Who Made Us at Suncorp Stadium! The cast brought Scottish music, dance and military precision together with international acts to celebrate heroes from home and overseas.

recentItems.title: 1 week to go (AU)
recentItems.description:
Just 1 week to go before The Heroes Who Made Us takes on Australia!    

There’s still time to experience the Show for yourself, with limited tickets available. Book now: https://eu1.hubs.ly/H0rvXj20

recentItems.title: The Heroes Who Made Us Closing Film 2025
recentItems.description:
Relive the spectacle of The Heroes Who Made Us with our closing film.

Come join us in 2026 with our Show, A Call to Gather, running 7-29 August! 

Buy tickets now: https://www.edintattoo.co.uk/

recentItems.title: A Tattoo Icon: Our Lone Piper
recentItems.description:
Arguably one of the most iconic performances at our Show, our Lone Piper stands on a platform high above the Esplanade on the Edinburgh Castle Ramparts to play a solo pipe performance.  

Audiences can watch this heroic sight live 7 – 29 August at our 2026 Show, A Call to Gather.

On sale now: https://www.edintattoo.co.uk/

recentItems.title: Tattoo Q & A
recentItems.description:
Last week, we collated your questions about our event, and now it’s time for answers! How do we select our music? What are our plans for narration in 2025? Hear from Tattoo Chief Executive, Jason Barrett, and Creative Director, Alan Lane, in this exclusive Q & A.

00:35 What are your goals for the next few years?
01:41 Will the Tattoo return to its roots in 2025?
03:05 Why keep calling yourself "military" Tattoo?
06:23 Will you bring back some element of verbal commentary?
08:00 Will there be an Evening Hymn, Last Post, Lone Piper, or Auld Lang Syne?
09:54 Why has the exit music been shortened?
10:50 How do you select the music for the Massed Pipes and Drums?

13:31 When will the Tattoo start paying civilian performers?

16:54 What will Alan bring to the Creative Director role?

18:57 What do you do for the rest of the year?
21:09 Why so many international acts?
24:02 How has the organisation changed post-Covid?
25:04 Where can you buy tickets?
25:23 Outro
